If you suspect bacterial contamination, put water out in direct sunlight in a shallow dish for at least half an hour. This will kill most bacteria in it. If you suspect other contamination let it sit out all day then gently pour only the top 2/3 into another container. This will allow non-solutes to settle out. If you suspect hearty bacteria or other solutes, or if it's a cloudy day your only option is to boil the water and collect the run-off from the steam. Obviously this last method works fine for seawater. If you can drink nothing else for days mix a little sea water back in, you want the minerals and a little salt.
